reference_pass_likelihood_pct.note: Assumed pass likelihood of a comparable continuously employed candidate; chosen so that a 3-year gap reproduces about 34%.

gap_penalty_pct_at_full.note: EV-001: 49% lower callback rate for women with career breaks (India).

gap_years_at_full_penalty.note: Penalty is scaled linearly up to this gap length and capped beyond it.

reframing_relative_lift_pct.note: EV-002: callbacks +15% versus gap-dated resumes (United Kingdom).

max_pass_likelihood_pct.note: Upper cap applied to every version.
